name: Ilaorun Illu
description: Renowned for its beautiful open gardens, the city features buildings with unique architecture, reflecting its designer’s perspective and forming a patchwork of styles. Its streets, lined with statues, complement the walls with beautiful paintings and frescoes. These artworks are not expressions of emotions but rather profound rational critiques and complex expressions of ideas made into art objects. The city council is composed of inventors, artists, and philosophers. While always open to new ideas, they are critical of any attempts to curb freedoms, create norms, or stifle innovation. However, they view personal responsibility as critical, with individuals needing to solve any damage caused by their actions. The ethos of Ilaorun Illu is to explore talents and articulate one’s unique viewpoints, spurring groundbreaking inventions, even at the cost of efficiency. For them, creativity and new connections of ideas are more valuable than material production. Most of its citizens are adepts of essential existentialism and often gather in public places to discuss their latest works and perspectives. They delve into magic and engineering to satisfy their preferences, display unique ideas, solve their personal problems, and not think about social use. The city’s workshops are filled with incredible inventions, and while some argue many are niche or inefficient, Ilaorun has also produced highly significant innovations. Ilaorun Illu is also a sanctuary for refugees fleeing tyranny, particularly scholars and artists. Here, they can contribute their thinking to the taii’maku discussions and are treated as equals. Often, revolutionaries and fugitive scholars seek the help of adventurers or mercenaries to scout them to Ilaorun and help them get accepted into it by the taii’makus. Currently, the council is divided in their discussion about T’ssir’s ideas. Some argue for freedom of research, as he is testing his theories on himself and taking responsibility. In contrast, others say his experiments turn one away from their essence and risk creating a fear of obsolescence in all those who do not accept it, and will ultimately force everyone to accept being transformed. Some counselors are secretly funding adventuring groups to investigate T’ssir and his guild to ensure they divulge all the risks.
